# Kig.wiki

## Docs

- [Where to Buy Padding and Shapewear for Kigurumi](https://kig.wiki/Buy/buy-padding-shapewear): List of popular padding and shapewear sellers for kigurumi performers. How to achieve that perfect anime style look with kigurumi cosplay.
- [Buying Used Kigurumi Mask: Guide & Safety Tips](https://kig.wiki/Buy/Buying Secondhand/buying-used-overview): Buying used kigurumi masks: where they're listed, what to check before purchase, and common risks to avoid.
- [Hadatai Stores and Where to Buy a Hadatai in 2026](https://kig.wiki/Buy/buying-hadatai): Where to buy hadatai: maker list, typical options, and what to look for when choosing sizing, fabric, and construction.
- [How to Order a Kigurumi Mask - Kigurumi Mask Commissioning](https://kig.wiki/Buy/mask-commissioning-guide): How kigurumi mask commissions work: what to ask makers, typical options, and how to reduce mistakes and misunderstandings.
- [Kigurumi Mask Makers & Stores List | Guide To The Best Kigurumi Masks 2026](https://kig.wiki/Buy/mask-maker-styles): Directory of kigurumi mask makers and sellers, with notes to help you compare options and understand what each offers.
- [Kigurumi Mask Sizing Options and Measurements](https://kig.wiki/Buy/mask-sizing-options): Sizing approaches for kigurumi masks: measurements, fit options, and how to choose sizing details for comfort and stability.
- [Kigurumi Taobao Guide for Buying Kigurumi Masks](https://kig.wiki/Buy/shopping-taobao-guide): How to buy kigurumi-related items through Taobao, including the typical workflow and issues buyers run into.
- [How To Maintain and Wash a Hadatai](https://kig.wiki/Care/cleaning-a-hadatai): How to wash and care for a hadatai, with handling tips to maintain fit, fabric condition, and longevity.
- [Cleaning Your Kigurumi Mask (Care Guide)](https://kig.wiki/Care/cleaning-mask): Practical guidance for cleaning and maintaining a kigurumi mask to keep it in good condition and reduce wear over time.
- [Kigurumi Mask Padding Guide (Fit & Comfort)](https://kig.wiki/Care/mask-padding): How to pad your Kigurumi Mask to best fit your head, guide for an optimal kigurumi mask fit to look your best.
- [How to Store a Kigurumi Mask](https://kig.wiki/Care/mask-storage): Storage methods for kigurumi masks: ways to protect shape, finish, and components during short and long-term storage.
- [Traveling With a Kigurumi Mask](https://kig.wiki/Care/traveling-with-kig-overview): Travel tips for kigurumi masks: packing, carry-on vs checked luggage considerations, and ways to avoid damage in transit.
- [Kigurumi Communities: Discords, Forums & Groups](https://kig.wiki/Community & Events/community-overview): Avoiding various pitfalls in kigurumi communities and various other protips.
- [Contributing Guide (How to Edit Kig.wiki)](https://kig.wiki/contributing): How to contribute to Kig.wiki: editing workflow, expectations, and the basic process for improving pages and resources.
- [Open-Source DIY Kigurumi Mask Resources (3D Models)](https://kig.wiki/DIY-mask/diy-mask-open-source-resources): Collection of open-source DIY kigurumi mask resources, including free 3D models and related materials.
- [DIY Kigurumi Mask: What to Expect Before You Start](https://kig.wiki/DIY-mask/reality-of-diy): What to know before attempting a DIY kigurumi mask: constraints, tradeoffs, and common surprises first-timers encounter.
- [Kigurumi Mask Wiki](https://kig.wiki/home): Kigurumi Mask Wiki: How to get into Kigurumi, Mask and Hadatai Makers, Kig Care, Troubleshooting, and Other Resources.
- [Kigurumi Glossary: Kig, Hadatai, Animegao & More](https://kig.wiki/Start/glossary): Glossary of common kigurumi terms (kig, hadatai, animegao, kiger, and more) in one reference list. Learn the meaning of common kigurumi terms.
- [Hadatai Basics: What is a Hadatai for Kigurumi Masks?](https://kig.wiki/Start/hadatai-overview): What a Hadatai (ハダタイ) is, how it's worn, and how it differs from zentai, plus common terminology and pitfalls.
- [Kigurumi Mask Padding Guide (Fit & Comfort)](https://kig.wiki/Start/hadatai-padding-theory): Concepts behind padding for kigurumi: shape, proportions, and fit. What padding changes and how to use it.
- [Kigurumi Handler's Guide](https://kig.wiki/Start/handlers-guide): Guide for kigurumi handlers, first time handler tips and handler's checklist. Learn how to be a great kigurumi handler.
- [Kigurumi Guide to Getting Started](https://kig.wiki/Start/introduction-beginner-path): Start here: the basic components, common first steps, and what to know before buying a kigurumi mask or hadatai. Get started with Kigurumi.
- [Kigurumi FAQ: Masks, Hadatai, Buying & Care](https://kig.wiki/Start/introduction-faq): Answers to common kigurumi questions about masks, hadatai, buying, care, comfort, and basic expectations for newcomers.
- [What Is Kigurumi? Kigurumi Masks Explained](https://kig.wiki/Start/introduction-what-is-kigurumi): Definition and overview of kigurumi masks, and how the hobby is commonly approached. How to get started with kigurumi cosplay.
- [Kigurumi Mask Basics: Types, Features and Buying Guide](https://kig.wiki/Start/mask-overview): Learn what kigurumi masks are like, common types and features, and practical considerations for fit, comfort, and use.
- [Kigurumi Troubleshooting: Common Mask & Hadatai Issues](https://kig.wiki/Start/troubleshooting): Troubleshooting common kigurumi issues and practical fixes, including fit, comfort, cleaning, and handling problems.
